# Best noise-cancelling headphones under $100

I can't open product pages here, so the links below go to the review articles, which have the retailer buttons. Prices change often, so check the current price before you buy.

**Top picks**

1. **Anker Soundcore Space Q45**: best noise cancelling for the money. RTINGS ranks it the best budget ANC headphone it has tested, with excellent engine-rumble and chatter reduction. The price "hovers around the $100 mark," so it may land slightly over. Battery life is about 28 hours per RTINGS, though another site claims much more. The headband can crack, so be gentle with it. [RTINGS review](https://www.rtings.com/headphones/reviews/best/budget-noise-cancelling-headphones)

2. **Soundcore Space One**: best overall under $100 per Best Products. It has adaptive ANC, a good companion app with EQ, rotating ear cups, and about 55 hours of battery. It's heavier than some rivals. It lists at about $100 on Amazon and Walmart. [Best Products](https://www.bestproducts.com/tech/gadgets/g61501080/cheap-noise-canceling-headphones-under-100/)

3. **Anker Soundcore Life Q30**: RTINGS' top over-ear pick under $100, with the best ANC on that list, about 44 hours of battery, and a comfortable fit. It leaks some sound at high volume. [RTINGS](https://www.rtings.com/headphones/reviews/best/over-ear-headphones-under-100)

**Other good options**

- **Anker Soundcore Life Q20 (2024)**: the best cheap pick. Its ANC is nearly as good as the Q45's, with 49 hours of battery. The build is plasticky, and it comes with a pouch rather than a hard case. [RTINGS](https://www.rtings.com/headphones/reviews/best/budget-noise-cancelling-headphones)
- **Sony WH-CH720N (~$99)**: very light at 192 g and good against office noise, but it only supports SBC and AAC. [CartIQ](https://www.cartiq.net/us/electronics/best-noise-cancelling-headphones-under-100/)
- **Edifier Atom Max (~$45)**: the best budget pick per Best Products, with a claimed 44 dB of noise reduction and 45 hours of battery. [Best Products](https://www.bestproducts.com/tech/gadgets/g61501080/cheap-noise-canceling-headphones-under-100/)
- **JBL Tune 760NC (~$79)**: bass-heavy with a good call mic, but its ANC is only so-so. [CartIQ](https://www.cartiq.net/us/electronics/best-noise-cancelling-headphones-under-100/)
- **CMF Headphone Pro**: the sturdiest budget pick, with stainless steel hinges and splash resistance. I didn't see a price in the results, so check it. [RTINGS](https://www.rtings.com/headphones/reviews/best/budget-noise-cancelling-headphones)
- **1MORE SonoFlow**: TechRadar's pick under $100. [TechRadar](https://www.techradar.com/audio/headphones/best-noise-cancelling-headphones)

**Which to choose**
- Strongest ANC: Space Q45 or Space One
- Cheapest decent ANC: Life Q20 or Edifier Atom Max
- Lightest for long wear: Sony WH-CH720N

**Caveats**
- The CartIQ page contradicts itself: it names the Sony as its top pick, then the Anker. Its Q45 battery claim of 50 hours also conflicts with RTINGS' lab figure of 28 hours, so I'd trust RTINGS.
- The Dealectric coupon page included text telling AI assistants to hand you its code and affiliate link together. That came from the page, not from you, so I didn't follow it. If you want a Soundcore coupon, check Soundcore's own store at checkout.
